Geographies Served Programs Programme for Colleges Enfold provides tailored programmes for college students and educators, addressing the absence of comprehensive sexuality and personal safety education in curricula. The organisation collaborates with UNICEF and educational bodies to integrate gender equity, sexuality education, and legal awareness into curricula. Enfold has developed resources and trained teachers in diverse fields, advocating for these subjects' inclusion in higher education across states and partnering with medical societies like FOGSI and IAP. Programme for Schools/NGOs Enfold's comprehensive 360-degree program addresses schools and NGOs, providing sessions for students, workshops for staff and parents, and safety systems for management. The core aim is to enhance students' physical, emotional, and sexual safety. Highlighting the urgent need for such programmes, national studies revealed alarming rates of child abuse and sexual abuse, often perpetrated by individuals known to the victims. Enfold recognizes the importance of instilling gender equity and respectful sexual behaviour among children to counter biased norms and stereotypes. Upholding children's rights to safety and dignity, the organisation believes in their potential to identify and report abuse, fostering emotional healing through professional support. By addressing sexuality and gender equitably, the programme empowers children to counter abuse, navigate puberty healthily, and interact respectfully. Programmes for Corporates Enfold's corporate programmes facilitate open discussions on sexuality, rights, and gender equity. Sessions cover personal safety, communication, and more. The organisation assists in establishing staff safety systems aligned with the POSH Act, offering training, workshops, and expert consultation. Enfold also introduces a sexual safety audit, evaluating practices and providing improvement suggestions. This comprehensive approach underscores its commitment to creating secure and equitable work environments. Programme for Individuals Enfold provides a range of training initiatives tailored for individuals striving to enhance gender empowerment and tackle sexual violence. These programmes accommodate diverse schedules and resources, catering to those dedicated to making a meaningful impact. The offerings encompass sessions like "Demystifying Sexuality," equipping participants to foster informed discussions. "Facilitator Training" is tailored for school personal safety and sexuality educators, while the "Internal Committee Member Training Programme" prepares individuals to contribute effectively. Additionally, Enfold's "Volunteer Training Programme" is designed for those seeking to actively engage in gender empowerment efforts and address sexual violence. These programmes reflect Enfold's commitment to equipping individuals with knowledge and skills to drive positive change in these critical areas. Programmes for LGBTQIA+ Enfold actively promotes LGBTQIA+ empowerment by fostering understanding, empathy, and acceptance. Recognizing the discrimination faced by LGBTQIA+ individuals, Enfold advocates equal rights, safety, and dignity. The organisation's education initiatives include discussions on gender identity, orientation, and diversity from grade 8 onwards, challenging misconceptions that fuel discrimination. Enfold collaborates with LGBTQIA+ NGOs, participates in Pride events, and assists companies in creating inclusive environments. Through counselling, resource development, and scientific education, Enfold contributes to cultivating a society that values and respects diverse gender identities and sexual orientations, Impact Metrics Total Number of Children Reached and Impacted Year-wise Metrics 2017-18 167630 2018-19 20058 2019-20 15554 2020-21 4111 Total Number of Schools, Colleges and Child Care Institutions Covered Year-wise Metrics 2017-18 549 2018-19 23 2019-20 19 2020-21 85 Milestones & Track Record Enfold developed the 'On Track' workbook series on Life Skills and Personal Safety for students, created the Enfold Suvidha Kit for children with disabilities, and established Collaborative Child Response Units (CCRUs) in partnership with UNICEF and the Karnataka government. --> --> Leadership Team Dr. Sangeeta Saksena Geetha Nair Director - Finance and CSR Bilquis Gangjee Director - Strategy and Collaboration Kushi Kushalappa Director - Support & Rehabilitation Swagata Raha Director - Research & Co - Director, Restorative Practices Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATE1247K Registration Number BNG(U)-BLR(S)/5372002-2003 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2018/0210895 --> 80G AAATE1247KF20224 12A AAATE1247KE20218 FCRA 94421634 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2002 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Specially Abled LGBTQ --> Impact Enfold India has positively impacted over 2,07,353 children and young adults across 735 educational institutions while sensitizing 59,783 parents, teachers, support staff, and corporate employees. Additionally, the organisation has trained 5,953 individuals from sectors such as police, medical, judicial, and media, as well as empowered 7,225 counsellors and social workers. Enfold's collaborative efforts extended to working with 496 professionals including CCI staff, JJB members, and Government officials Vision and Mission Enfold's vision is for all children to live in safe environments with dignity, enjoying their rights, while their mission is to build safe and inclusive communities through empowering individuals to claim and exercise their right to live with dignity and safety.
